title: A Detailed Proof of the Chudnovsky Formula
abstract: Formalizes the Chudnovsky brothers' rapidly convergent series for 1/π, proving Mathlib's `chudnovskySum = π⁻¹`. Follows Milla's elementary complex-analytic proof: Weierstrass and Eisenstein theory, Liouville and parallelogram-residue calculus, the Kummer hypergeometric bridge and the main modular identity relating the j-invariant to the lattice periods, Baker's division-value machinery, and the singular-moduli inputs at the CM point τ = (1 + √-163)/2 — integrality of j(τ) via modular polynomials and Kronecker's congruence, and rationality of the Weierstrass s₂ invariant via Masser's Appendix A.1.

informal.Chudnovsky.chudnovskySum_eq_pi_inv: Proves the Chudnovsky series identity, i.e. Mathlib's `chudnovskySum = π⁻¹`: the series (12 / 640320^(3/2)) · ∑ₙ (-1)ⁿ (6n)! (545140134 n + 13591409) / ((3n)! (n!)³ 640320^(3n)) sums to 1/π.
